3899-7084-8337.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, M'Ress triggers, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

4968-6593-8320.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Yoshimaru.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
4968-6593-8320.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

4772-7282-8160.easyPrerequisites:
Kwia's ability hasn't triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
4772-7282-8160.description:
Gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating two Lotus tokens due to Doubling Season.
Activate a Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating two token copies of the Lotus token.
Activate two Loti by tapping and sacrificing them, adding six mana of any color.
Repeat from step 4.
4772-7282-8160.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Chrome Dome can target other artifacts as desired.

2692-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
2692-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, either putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control and granting them vigilance until end of turn or creating a 2/2 white Cat Beast creature token
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1263-4871-5670-7192.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-4871-5670-7192.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Grave Venerations and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
without summoning sickness, is a creature and with at least X +1/+1 counter(s) on it

3259-7759-8201.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
3259-7759-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7759-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1479-2841-5671-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2841-5671-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and The Necrobloom trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

240-1879-3899-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2415-2438-5070.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2438-5070.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

81-4091-7791.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1170-1329-4211-5434.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2263-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
2263-5147-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

215-3464-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other creatures
215-3464-7203.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Brigid
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

2743-6669-7317.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Here Comes a New Hero! by paying {5}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Here Comes a New Hero! twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Here Comes a New Hero!s, copying Biovisionary three times and causing a player to draw nine cards.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1339-2122-5231-7315.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-5231-7315.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2034-6291-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-6291-7306.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Stridehangar Automaton.
Activate the Mutagen token by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature token.
Repeat.

1409-1770-5420.description:
Activate Plundering Pirate by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Pirate enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Plundering Pirate.
Resolve both Plundering Pirate triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

284-413-6972--112.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Angel of Invention.
When Angel of Invention dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Angel of Invention enters, its fabricate ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Angel of Invention ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
284-413-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Angel of Invention's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1224-4067-5922.notablePrerequisites: Helga does not have summoning sickness and has power 5 or greater.
1224-4067-5922.description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells with mana value 4 or greater or creature spells with {X} in their mana cost.
Cast Psychic Pickpocket by paying {4}{U}.
Helga triggers, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
When Psychic Pickpocket enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing it to connive and returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Helga.
Repeat.
1224-4067-5922.notes: If you have enough leftover mana to cast the creature, you can instead substitute untapping another permanent instead of Helga.

1987-3227-3277-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-3227-3277-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Izzet Chronarch and Scrivener.
When Izzet Chronarch and Scrivener enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3227-3277-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

3705-5231-6277-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Squee and the creature token, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

3693-4613-6582.description:
Activate Aerith Gainsborough by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Aerith Gainsborough triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

803-3951-5703-6645.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr or Gogo.
803-3951-5703-6645.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Gogo triggers, causing it to become a copy of Altaïr with its name not changing, and causing both Gogo and Altaïr to get +2/+0 and haste until end of turn.
Declare Gogo and Altaïr as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the Godo trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

3000-5670-6578.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-5670-6578.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.
3000-5670-6578.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

1379-2034-5346-6520.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more opponents.
1379-2034-5346-6520.notablePrerequisites: You control two creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
1379-2034-5346-6520.description:
Declare two creatures you control as attackers, attacking two different opponents.
Holding priority, activate Nemesis Phoenix by paying {2}{R}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nemesis Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
When Nemesis Phoenix dies, Crime Novelist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

600-1124-1543.notablePrerequisites: Jace has at least five loyalty counters on it.
600-1124-1543.description:
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' abilities this turn.
Activate Jace's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two token copies of Jace that aren't legendary.
Activate a Jace token by putting no loyalty counters on it, putting a loyalty counter on it and the other Jace token.
Repeat step 3 using the other Jace token.
Activate a Jace token's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two token copies of Jace that aren't legendary.
Repeat from step 3.
600-1124-1543.notes: You may use the infinite Jace tokens to get infinite Illusion creature tokens.

225-1479-2638-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-2638-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-2178-5663.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Cayth.
Cayth does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one creature token.
2034-2178-5663.description:
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of a creature token you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Cayth triggers, untapping Cayth.
Repeat.

116-390-2569.notablePrerequisites:
Hulking Metamorph is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Hulking Metamorph do not have summoning sickness.
116-390-2569.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Hulking Metamorph.
Activate Hulking Metamorph by tapping it.
When Hulking Metamorph becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Hulking Metamorph's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1860-2067-4196.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Court of Embereth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they have flash.
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Resolve the Court of Embereth trigger, creating a 3/1 Knight creature token, then dealing damage to each opponent equal to the number of creatures you control.
Each opponent whose life total is less than or equal to the number of creatures you control loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

2011-2446-4050.notablePrerequisites: Living Hive does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2011-2446-4050.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Living Hive.
Living Hive triggers, creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar at least five times by sacrificing at least five Insects, adding at least {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

640-2173-5010-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

967-1806-2034-4666.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Planar Void triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Cast Eternal Scourge for {3}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Eternal Scourge, allowing it to enter the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2286-3883.description: On each of your opponent' draw steps, Teferi's Puzzle Box triggers, shuffling their hands into their libraries and drawing them 0 cards, giving you treasures equal to the number of cards they would have drawn.

565-1858-2792.notablePrerequisites:
Lands able to tap for {1}{U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-2792.description:
Cast View from Above targeting Great Whale.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
The token Great Whale enters, untapping seven lands you control.
View from Above resolves, returning to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other permanents you control in step 1, gaining infinite copies of those permanents in step 2.
